next_step: Finalize EU-region POC SOW, confirm Dedicated pricing band, security addendum review
blockers: Dedicated pricing vs hosted burst economics
notes:
- Target: replace legacy search + heuristics with embeddings + reranking for product help and in-app assistant.
- Initial ask: low-latency chat in EU for EU customers (GDPR/sovereignty).
- Flow: start on Hosted API (EU region) -> POC (2 weeks) -> evaluate Dedicated for steady traffic.
- POC agreed: 2-week eval using hosted eu-west endpoint, dataset = 120k doc fragments (support KB + release notes), test queries: 1k qps burst / 15 qps sustained per team.
- Observations from demo (2026-02-18): p50 ~ 60ms token, p95 ~ 140ms for 128-token decode in eu-west hosted. Cross-region to us-east added ~130-180ms on top (too high for live assistant).
- Customer quote: "Latency is the gating factor for our in-product assistant — anything over ~200ms round-trip feels sluggish."
- Model preference: open-models (Llama2/Variant), prefer quantized 16/8-bit to reduce cost; want Redwood-verified model profiles.
- Security asks: full SOC2 details, KMS integration for key management, audit log retention 1 year, ability to restrict logs to EU region.
- Legal: asks for data residency addendum + EU data processing clause (DPAs). Legal sign-off required before Dedicated procurement.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget; open to Dedicated if cost/throughput beats hosted long-term (3x-6x committed vs burst).
- Routing requirement: multi-region routing with strict EU-only primary and fallback to US only on explicit SLA breach; prefer ability to set routing policy per route.
- SE notes (Miguel): Evaluate batching windows — aggressive batching helps cost but raises tail latency for small chats. Need profiling during POC.
- Next technical milestone: run 48-hour soak with synthetic traffic (15 qps sustained, 1k qps bursts) in eu-west hosted with KV/prefix caching enabled. Collect token-cost, p95 latency, memory/kv eviction stats.
- Blocker summary: final pricing, DPA/legal, timeline for Dedicated EU region (ETA?), clarification on encrypted logs residency.
- Suggested SOW: 4-week timeline: week 1 hosted POC + profiling; week 2 iterate prompts & caching; week 3 dedicated sizing proposal; week 4 legal & pricing review.
- Internal champion: Head of Product, Clara Mfcller (spearheading demo + requirements).
- Next meeting: pricing review w/ Aisha + SE on 2026-03-15 (tentative).
